miniscent-level 1
# A sample of level scripting. Three rooms in a row, split by two doors: shoot
# the switches to open the first, find the keycard to open the second. The
# terminal turns the guards friendly. Wiring is all in facility.st.
#
# The rooms are dressed in the 256 px room surfaces at 0.03125 units a texel (a
# tile every 8 units), so each face is a brush plane with its own material.
#
# Pack it after an edit:
#   cargo run --release -p miniscent-game -- --pack-level assets/levels/facility.txt assets/levels/facility.msl
# The rooms, carved first so that nothing added later is carved again.
